import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import xgboost as xgb
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import mean_squared_error
import os
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Set random seed for reproducibility
np.random.seed(42)

# Create submission directory
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load data
print("Loading training data...")
labels = pd.read_csv("./input/labels.csv")
test_data = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_submission = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

print(f"Train shape: {labels.shape}")
print(f"Test shape: {test_data.shape}")

# Filter training data to remove corrupted coordinates
print("Filtering corrupted coordinates from training data...")
valid_mask = (
    (labels["pickup_latitude"].notna())
    & (labels["dropoff_latitude"].notna())
    & (labels["pickup_longitude"].notna())
    & (labels["dropoff_longitude"].notna())
    & (labels["pickup_latitude"] >= -90)
    & (labels["pickup_latitude"] <= 90)
    & (labels["dropoff_latitude"] >= -90)
    & (labels["dropoff_latitude"] <= 90)
    & (labels["pickup_longitude"] >= -180)
    & (labels["pickup_longitude"] <= 180)
    & (labels["dropoff_longitude"] >= -180)
    & (labels["dropoff_longitude"] <= 180)
)

labels_filtered = labels[valid_mask].copy()
print(f"Train after filtering: {labels_filtered.shape}")

# Determine clipping bounds from test data
test_pickup_lat_min = test_data["pickup_latitude"].min()
test_pickup_lat_max = test_data["pickup_latitude"].max()
test_pickup_lon_min = test_data["pickup_longitude"].min()
test_pickup_lon_max = test_data["pickup_longitude"].max()
test_dropoff_lat_min = test_data["dropoff_latitude"].min()
test_dropoff_lat_max = test_data["dropoff_latitude"].max()
test_dropoff_lon_min = test_data["dropoff_longitude"].min()
test_dropoff_lon_max = test_data["dropoff_longitude"].max()

print(
    f"Clipping bounds - lat: [{test_pickup_lat_min}, {test_pickup_lat_max}], lon: [{test_pickup_lon_min}, {test_pickup_lon_max}]"
)


# Extract features
def extract_features(df, clip_lat_min, clip_lat_max, clip_lon_min, clip_lon_max):
    df = df.copy()

    # Convert datetime
    df["pickup_datetime"] = pd.to_datetime(df["pickup_datetime"])

    # Time features
    df["hour"] = df["pickup_datetime"].dt.hour
    df["day_of_week"] = df["pickup_datetime"].dt.dayofweek
    df["day_of_month"] = df["pickup_datetime"].dt.day
    df["is_weekend"] = (df["day_of_week"] >= 5).astype(int)
    df["is_night"] = (
        (df["pickup_datetime"].dt.hour >= 23) | (df["pickup_datetime"].dt.hour <= 5)
    ).astype(int)

    # Clip coordinates to test data bounds
    df["pickup_latitude"] = df["pickup_latitude"].clip(clip_lat_min, clip_lat_max)
    df["pickup_longitude"] = df["pickup_longitude"].clip(clip_lon_min, clip_lon_max)
    df["dropoff_latitude"] = df["dropoff_latitude"].clip(
        test_dropoff_lat_min, test_dropoff_lat_max
    )
    df["dropoff_longitude"] = df["dropoff_longitude"].clip(
        test_dropoff_lon_min, test_dropoff_lon_max
    )

    # Manhattan distance
    df["pickup_dropoff_dist"] = (
        df["dropoff_latitude"] - df["pickup_latitude"]
    ).abs() + (df["dropoff_longitude"] - df["pickup_longitude"]).abs()

    return df


# Process train and test with consistent clipping bounds
print("Extracting features...")
train = extract_features(
    labels_filtered,
    test_pickup_lat_min,
    test_pickup_lat_max,
    test_pickup_lon_min,
    test_pickup_lon_max,
)
test = extract_features(
    test_data,
    test_pickup_lat_min,
    test_pickup_lat_max,
    test_pickup_lon_min,
    test_pickup_lon_max,
)

# Feature columns
feature_cols = [
    "pickup_latitude",
    "pickup_longitude",
    "dropoff_latitude",
    "dropoff_longitude",
    "passenger_count",
    "hour",
    "day_of_week",
    "day_of_month",
    "is_weekend",
    "is_night",
    "pickup_dropoff_dist",
]

# Prepare data for training
X_train = train[feature_cols].values
y_train = train["fare_amount"].values
X_test = test[feature_cols].values

# Create hold-out validation set
X_tr, X_val, y_tr, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train, y_train, test_size=0.1, random_state=42, shuffle=True
)

print(f"Train split: {len(X_tr)}, Validation split: {len(X_val)}")

# Train XGBoost model with optimized hyperparameters
print("Training XGBoost model...")
model = xgb.XGBRegressor(
    n_estimators=200,
    max_depth=6,
    learning_rate=0.1,
    subsample=0.8,
    colsample_bytree=0.8,
    min_child_weight=1,
    gamma=0.1,
    reg_alpha=0.1,
    reg_lambda=1,
    random_state=42,
    n_jobs=-1,
    tree_method="hist",
    verbosity=0,
)

model.fit(X_tr, y_tr, eval_set=[(X_val, y_val)], verbose=False)

# Validate on hold-out set
y_pred_val = model.predict(X_val)
rmse_val = np.sqrt(mean_squared_error(y_val, y_pred_val))
print(f"\nValidation RMSE: {rmse_val:.4f}")

# Predict on test set
print("Predicting on test set...")
y_pred_test = model.predict(X_test)

# Create submission file
print("Creating submission file...")
submission = pd.DataFrame({"key": test_data["key"], "fare_amount": y_pred_test})

# Ensure proper float format
submission["fare_amount"] = submission["fare_amount"].round(2)

submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print(f"Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
print(f"Submission shape: {submission.shape}")
